name: 花卉租赁变更明细钻取 V2.2.3
description: 适配 DTS v2.2.3；内部。依据花卉 V2 模型及已登记 ODS 日志；空金额保留为空，不将未知值视为零。

sqlConfig.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name::text AS label, project_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT a.*,o.order_code,c.customer_name,CASE a.change_type WHEN 1 THEN '销售金额变更' WHEN 2 THEN '库房物品变更' WHEN 3 THEN '成本变更' WHEN 4 THEN '起租减租变更' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,(a.after_total_amount-a.before_total_amount) AS amount_delta,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.confirmed_time-a.apply_time))/86400 AS confirm_days FROM public.prs_v2_ads_change_detail a LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o ON a.order_id=o.order_id AND a.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.tenant_id WHERE a.change_status IN (1,2)) options WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

SELECT DISTINCT type_name::text AS label, type_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT a.*,o.order_code,c.customer_name,CASE a.change_type WHEN 1 THEN '销售金额变更' WHEN 2 THEN '库房物品变更' WHEN 3 THEN '成本变更' WHEN 4 THEN '起租减租变更' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,(a.after_total_amount-a.before_total_amount) AS amount_delta,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.confirmed_time-a.apply_time))/86400 AS confirm_days FROM public.prs_v2_ads_change_detail a LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o ON a.order_id=o.order_id AND a.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.tenant_id WHERE a.change_status IN (1,2)) options WHERE type_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

WITH b AS (SELECT a.*,o.order_code,c.customer_name,CASE a.change_type WHEN 1 THEN '销售金额变更' WHEN 2 THEN '库房物品变更' WHEN 3 THEN '成本变更' WHEN 4 THEN '起租减租变更' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,(a.after_total_amount-a.before_total_amount) AS amount_delta,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.confirmed_time-a.apply_time))/86400 AS confirm_days FROM public.prs_v2_ads_change_detail a LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o ON a.order_id=o.order_id AND a.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.tenant_id WHERE a.change_status IN (1,2)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "变更数", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN change_status=2 AND change_type IN (1,3) THEN amount_delta END)::numeric,2) AS "已确认金额差额", ROUND(AVG(confirm_days) FILTER (WHERE confirm_days>=0)::numeric,2) AS "平均确认天数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE change_type=4) AS "起租减租变更数" FROM b WHERE apply_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND apply_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND type_name = {{changeType}}]]

WITH b AS (SELECT a.*,o.order_code,c.customer_name,CASE a.change_type WHEN 1 THEN '销售金额变更' WHEN 2 THEN '库房物品变更' WHEN 3 THEN '成本变更' WHEN 4 THEN '起租减租变更' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,(a.after_total_amount-a.before_total_amount) AS amount_delta,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.confirmed_time-a.apply_time))/86400 AS confirm_days FROM public.prs_v2_ads_change_detail a LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o ON a.order_id=o.order_id AND a.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.tenant_id WHERE a.change_status IN (1,2)) SELECT change_code AS "变更单号", order_code AS "报花单号", project_name AS "项目", type_name AS "变更类型", apply_time AS "申请时间", confirmed_time AS "确认时间", amount_delta AS "金额差额" FROM b WHERE apply_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND apply_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND type_name = {{changeType}}]] ORDER BY apply_time DESC LIMIT 300

WITH b AS (SELECT a.*,o.order_code,c.customer_name,CASE a.change_type WHEN 1 THEN '销售金额变更' WHEN 2 THEN '库房物品变更' WHEN 3 THEN '成本变更' WHEN 4 THEN '起租减租变更' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,(a.after_total_amount-a.before_total_amount) AS amount_delta,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.confirmed_time-a.apply_time))/86400 AS confirm_days FROM public.prs_v2_ads_change_detail a LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o ON a.order_id=o.order_id AND a.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.tenant_id WHERE a.change_status IN (1,2)) SELECT change_code AS "变更单号", project_name AS "项目", before_good_price_id AS "原货品价格ID", after_good_price_id AS "新货品价格ID", change_quantity AS "变更数量" FROM b WHERE apply_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND apply_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND type_name = {{changeType}}]] AND change_type=2 ORDER BY apply_time DESC LIMIT 100

components.name: 租期调整日志（按项目与日期）

sqlConfig.query: WITH b AS (SELECT l.id,l.biz_id AS order_id,l.rent_time_type,l.old_rent_time,l.new_rent_time,l.change_user_name,l.change_time,o.order_code,o.project_name,(l.new_rent_time::date-l.old_rent_time::date) AS day_delta FROM public.ods_prst_flower_rent_time_log l JOIN (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) o ON o.order_id=l.biz_id) SELECT order_code AS "报花单号", project_name AS "项目", old_rent_time AS "原租期日期", new_rent_time AS "新租期日期", day_delta AS "变化天数", change_user_name AS "变更人", change_time AS "变更时间" FROM b WHERE change_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND change_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] ORDER BY change_time DESC LIMIT 100
